name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: Removes stale, keyless duplicate copies of your OS Client Certs signing certificate that NSS sometimes caches into cert9.db from verified S/MIME signatures, which can silently break outgoing S/MIME signing. v0.8.0 is the proactive-only architecture validated through the 0.6.4.x test series: a new compose window unconditionally rebuilds Gecko's CertVerifier; the Send button/menu, intercepted before the real send, removes a stale duplicate by pure SQL -- no NSS call -- so reading incoming mail stays intact (0.6.4.1 proved any nsIX509CertDB enumeration on the send path corrupts reading; the duplicate is found via the CKA_NSS_EMAIL column ace534352 with a case-insensitive match on the identity's email); app shutdown runs a full v0.6.3-style pass. No reactive failure-handling or retry. See README.md.
